content.short: SundaeSwap is a premier decentralized exchange on Cardano featuring an innovative AMM liquidity model.
content.description: SundaeSwap is one of the most prominent decentralized exchanges (DEXs) on the Cardano blockchain, known for being the first to implement a functional Automated Market Maker (AMM) model. The platform allows users to swap native tokens, provide liquidity, and participate in yield farming in a completely non-custodial environment. Governed by a decentralized autonomous organization (DAO), SundaeSwap prioritizes community-led growth and technical excellence. By spearheaded new technologies and spearheading DeFi adoption, SundaeSwap serves as a vital hub for global financial services on Cardano.
content.meta: SundaeSwap is a leading Cardano AMM DEX for token swaps, liquidity provision, and yield farming. Explore it now on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
